Who We Are
 At adorsys, we are not just developers and analysts; we are pioneers shaping the digital future for banking and insurance sectors.  What Awaits You
 We are seeking a Senior Fullstack Developer to join the project team responsible for the migration of a people management system . You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining cloud-based applications, ensuring technical excellence and high-quality deliverables across both backend and frontend components.Development and maintenance of high-performance backend systems with Spring Boot and Java 21 (or older, at least Java 8)
Lead the development and maintenance of backend services using Java, Spring Boot, OpenAPI, Cucumber
Drive frontend development using Angular, Typescript, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Ensure smooth integration within the Cloudfoundry environment
Design and manage database solutions with MongoDB and PostgresDB
Implement secure authentication and authorization using Keycloak
Maintain code quality and compliance using tools like Maven, Sonar, Mend, Fortify
Set up monitoring and observability through Grafana
Build event-driven architectures using Kafka
Apply structured architectural practices (e.g., Arc42) to deliver scalable solutions
Collaborate in version control and CI/CD workflows using GitHub
Provide technical guidance, coaching, and support to team members
 Your profile
 Must-haves:
Several years of professional experience as a Fullstack Developer in senior or lead roles
Strong backend development expertise: Java, Spring Boot, OpenAPI, Cucumber
Solid frontend development skills: Angular, Typescript, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, especially Cloudfoundry
Strong knowledge of databases: MongoDB, PostgresDB
Familiarity with security frameworks like Keycloak
Experience using CI/CD and code quality tools (Maven, Sonar, Mend, Fortify)
Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Grafana
Knowledge of messaging systems like Kafka
Understanding of architectural frameworks like Arc42
Fluent German language skills (written and spoken); English is a plus
 Additional Advantage:
Prior experience in migration projects, particularly the migration of complex systems or applications

 We're not just offering a job; we're inviting you to be part of a movement. With us, you'll navigate the exciting terrain of finance and banking and contribute to sustainable financial living.
